notes.title: Discord + New game in alpha!
notes.content: [h2]Discord[/h2][p]I now have a Discord server! Join to get the latest news about my projects, or just to discuss and chat![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/YwBvrmDAkx"]https://discord.gg/YwBvrmDAkx[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Blade of One[/h2][p]I'm working on a new game! It's got swords![/p][p]There's a free demo as well![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3466580/Blade_of_One/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you're interested, I'm currently hosting an alpha playtest on my Discord! Join to learn more![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SPASE DEFENSE?[/h2][p]It's not over yet! I'll admit, I started working on the game years back in high school and it can be a bit rough adding new stuff to the game. Kinda like adding electricity and plumbing to a centuries old home.[/p][p][/p][p]I have some ideas for a major content update (weapons, enemies, more??) but nothing's set in stone yet until Blade of One is released. Maybe you can provoke me in the [i]Discord?[/i] (last Discord plug I swear 😅🙏)[/p][p][/p][p]TL;DR: game ain't dead! next update tbd.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading![/p]

notes.title: The Cheevo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/cc8da87514b954f24091fa6449a858a84791bfac.png[/img]

[h1]1.1 - The Cheevo Update[/h1]

[b]Achievements[/b]
16 new Steam Achievements to earn!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/c82f5fd5c7972075a54b0baae972920b12f580b8.png[/img]

[b]Background Customization[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now choose backgrounds regardless of gamemode!
[*] New Customization menu (available in Collection)
[*] Multiple backgrounds can be selected and will be picked at random each playthrough
[*] Gamemode-specific backgrounds become available when said mode is unlocked
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/ccf508b5020d92f44125760f1dc6249ee50f62af.png[/img]

[b]New Maps[/b]
With choice comes choices! These maps can be purchased in the Store.

[b]Beveled[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/9a5e2e9ed043e42bde17250de99bd11e041c3261.png[/img]

[b]Forest[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/6f07ab6ed3cade0937d7077d00e7e2f75ce18b7c.png[/img]

[b]Cobalt[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/b3da9a26f1ae6ff8e138905d59ee09bb17d9674b.png[/img]

[b]New Rocks[/b]
[list]
[*] Debris created by explosions and impacts now match the ground they come from
[*] Yes this was very necessary!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/096d79d0f13125016b11177d9b93496697d59868.png[/img]

[b]Controller Remapping[/b]
You can now edit controller bindings for each player in the settings!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/c7190e5b312a69f0acb8399ab369be4892fcf9ee.png[/img]


[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed text clipping in the mode select
[*] Fixed a potential crash involving homing projectiles and aiming enemies
[/list]

[h3]Tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated credits
[*] Made Wave 9 slightly easier
[*] Increased Burst Launcher direct damage (5 -> 7)
[*] Decreased Burst Rifle firing speed (1.05s -> 1.25s)
[*] Tweaked Wave 9 to be more interesting and a little easier
[*] Antillery HP decrease (15 -> 12)
[*] Tallbug HP decrease (34 -> 28)
[*] Big Groath move speed decrease
[/list]
[b]Tankbug rework[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated art
[*] Shoot speed decrease (2.5s -> 3s)
[*] Can now jump to first platform
[*] Can now angle shots to hit players from above or below
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111025/1ee4ea2dff638662e09b71c38f413069de071bf1.png[/img]
[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a basic help section on the main menu that becomes available after completing the tutorial
[*] Added strafing to the tutorial 
(Hold the A key or right bumper while moving. You will not change direction!)
[*] Added a YouTube link to Credits
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing selection sound for mode select
[*] Collection screen music should now loop
[*] Fixed missing Blork tooth
[*] Fixed idle music not changing between maps
[*] Fixed a potential softlock with a wave 10 boss
[/list]

[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decreased attack speed of some late game enemies
[*] Increased hurtbox size on some enemies, making them easier to hit
[*] Medkit now drops 3 health items instead of 2
[*] Medkit now instantly revives players to full health instead of half
[*] Free throwables in late game now drop in a greater radius
[*] Bertha rocket health no longer scales to player count
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed backgrounds not changing from the default one
[*] Fixed mode select desyncing and becoming offset
[*] Fixed wins not being saved
[*] Fixed gamemodes not appearing as unlocked when freshly opening the game
[*] Fixed throwable pickups making wrong sound in multiplayer
[*] Fixed incorrect portrait in Bestiary
[*] Escape sequence difficulty now scales to player count
[*] Ralien Tank health increased from 120 to 140
[/list]

[h3]Bug Bertha[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a strange bug where mid-air babies could be knocked far away and cause a softlock
[*] Now drops health instead of armor when hit with grenades
[/list]
[h3]Nautilaur[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tweaked beam attack animation and duration
[/list]
[h3]Randomizer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a sound effect for when weapons switch
[*] Fixed some gun sounds persisting after weapon switch
[/list]
[h3]Endless[/h3]
[list]
[*] Highest wave reached is now shown on mode select
[/list]
